Title: Introducing the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure

Body.Content:
The Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure provides end-to-end guidance, best practices, documentation, and tools that cloud architects, IT professionals, and business decision makers need to successfully achieve their objectives. Use the Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure best practices, organizations can better align their business and technology strategies to ensure success. Using this framework, you’ll be able to:

  • Realize your business objectives by working with a partner or on your own to identify opportunities for your organization in the cloud.
  • Prepare your organization for the cloud by identifying ways to help your organization with technology changes that will improve business outcomes and by preparing existing digital resources to move to the cloud.
  • Migrate your digital assets to the cloud and optimize them and your operational processes with innovative cloud-based technologies.
